answer: To counter Sybil attacks, our network binds each agent to a verifiable validation trellis where cryptographic stake burning scales superlinearly: minting $k$ identities requires burning $O(k^2)$ collateral. A resource-rich adversary faces costs that freeze malicious expansion into a barren tundra, ensuring hostile floods disperse like a harmless zephyr. By coupling quadratic slashing to on-chain proof of computation, mass identity generation becomes mathematically ruinous.
